unchanged_content_freshness_rule.why: The host uses sourceCompletedAt, not TSV hash or object age. Skipping every write forever for unchanged bytes would cause503 after48hours.
unchanged_content_freshness_rule.allowed_design: Reuse same immutable content only after a fresh successful complete source scan; independently bind current manifest and update its real verified source timestamp through the reviewed guarded path.
unchanged_content_freshness_rule.prohibited: Refreshing timestamps from the previous snapshot, polling timestamps only, weakening maxFeedAgeHours or claiming freshness from an unchanged hash alone.

single_writer_and_idempotency.preserve: Merchant owns bucket merchant/us-en/current.json; parent dispatches work but does not publish. No overlap with rejected Worker job, another local run, manual Merchant refresh packet or other market publishers.
single_writer_and_idempotency.same_job_retry: First compare current pointer/object with the exact intended hash and source verification time; if already committed, verify and record completion without duplicate mutation.
single_writer_and_idempotency.important_gap: Local CLI does not itself implement scheduler ownership, a process lock, remote conditional update or publish transaction; uploader details must be reviewed before action.

failure_and_rollback.before_promotion: Any incomplete/failed read, failed validation, mismatch or failed immutable verification leaves the last known complete pointer unchanged. Never publish an empty/partial fallback.
failure_and_rollback.after_promotion: Verify actual before/after first. Restore only a retained independently valid complete US manifest/object when supported by current source truth and the same guarded writer path. Do not automatically revert to the old known-broken229918.99prices or a source-stale version. A fresh corrected build may be required instead of rollback.
failure_and_rollback.google_limit: Restoring the hosted pointer is not an immediate Google rollback. Subsequent successful fetch/processing/effective-offer readback is necessary. Host503 also is not proof that Google stopped displaying its previously received data.
failure_and_rollback.privacy: No credentials, customer/order data or source/vendor URLs in public feed, diagnostics or report; credential file contents are never emitted or sent to Cloudflare.

availability_and_lag.local_dependency: The Mac must be powered/awake, Codex app/local automation must be able to run, network access and the existing Shopify/Cloudflare authorizations must remain valid. This is an interim local operation, not always-on server automation.
availability_and_lag.while_mac_offline: The existing Cloudflare read-only host can serve its last verified object independently until the configured48hour source-age limit. Local reads and refreshes cannot run while the host is asleep/offline; do not claim a guaranteed cadence.

availability_and_lag.cadence_gap: Existing parent30minute heartbeat is not evidence of a wired or completed local feed run. Actual command, owner dispatch and completed run/readback must be recorded. No scheduler activation is included.
